title: Java Shopping Cart
summary: A simple Java Swing shopping cart system for users who need a basic desktop storefront and cart workflow.
role: Built a desktop shopping cart application with Java Swing UI and core cart functionality
overview: Java Shopping Cart is a simple desktop shopping cart system built with Java Swing. It is intended for demonstrating a basic GUI-based shopping workflow in a Java application.

features.title: Swing-based interface
features.body: Provides a simple desktop GUI for browsing and interacting with shopping cart actions. The interface is built entirely with Java Swing for a lightweight Java desktop experience.

features.title: Cart workflow
features.body: Supports the core shopping cart flow, letting users add items and manage their selections in the application. It is designed as a straightforward example of cart logic in a desktop project.
